description:
[Calculators] Price a Rust base: build/upgrade cost, upkeep, decay, HP and the cheapest raid path. The base designer's numbers for one design (https://rust.wiki/base-designer): `cost` (twig `placement`,
`upgrade`, `deployables` = door/deployable recipes, `total`), `upkeep` (`per_day`/`per_week` by resource, `rate_pct`
= the bracketed tax rate over `blocks`, `group_multiplier`), `hp`, `decay` (if the TC runs dry: `first_piece_hours`,
`tc_open_hours` = when a free way in to the TC opens, `all_gone_hours`), and `raid`: the cheapest path from outside to
the TC (`raid.tc`), to each loot room (`raid.loot`) and the whole raid (`raid.full`, TC first then each loot room).
Each path has `sulfur` (or `seconds`/`tools` in eco mode), `explosives`, `raw` resources and its `layers` in order
(piece index, name, the explosives for that layer, `side` soft/hard for eco raids, `splash` onto nearby pieces).
Layers marked `unverified` are foundation steps, priced like a wall of the same grade as the game files say (pending
an in-game check). `page` opens the same base in the 3D designer. Pieces the design gets wrong come back in `warnings`. Use for 'how much to build / upkeep / raid my base': pass size=2x2 (+ floors, grade, door) for a plain base, template= for an example, or design= (JSON or a rust.wiki/base-designer link the user shares). raid.tc is the cheapest way to the tool cupboard, layer by layer. Give the user `page`: it opens the base in the 3D designer.

design.description: A design as JSON: {"v":1,"p":[pieces]}, each piece {"t": type, "g": grade, "x": m, "z": m, "l": level, "r": degrees[, "y": m for wall/ceiling deployables]} - see /base-designer/pieces for the types (every placeable deployable included) and the coordinate rules. A rust.wiki/base-designer#d=... share link (or just its d= code) works too.

door.description: With `size`: the front door's item shortname.

explosives.description: `staples` (rockets, C4, satchels, explosive ammo, beancans), `all`, or a comma list of explosive shortnames.

grade.description: With `size`: the grade of every piece.

mode.description: `mix` (cheapest mix of explosives per piece, the raid calculator's default), `single` (one explosive per piece) or `eco` (melee, priced in seconds of work - soft sides matter).

players.description: Players authorised on the TC (5 or more pay group upkeep).

size.description: Instead of `design`: a plain rectangular base of W x D square foundations, walls all round, one front door, the TC and two large boxes inside - e.g. 2x2.

template.description: One of the example bases instead of `design`.

timeline.description: Include the decay timeline (hours, piece index) per destroyed piece.

name: evaluate_base_design
title: Price a Rust base: build/upgrade cost, upkeep, decay, HP and the cheapest raid path
